headline: Netcraft Names Industry Veterans Susan Koski and Kelly Bissell as Strategic Advisors
summary: Netcraft, the global leader in brand protection and threat disruption, today announced that Susan Koski and Kelly Bissell, two of the industry's most respected leaders in enterprise security and fraud, have joined Netcraft as strategic advisors.

headline: Lynda Petherick named New Look CEO
summary: New Look has announced Lynda Petherick as its next chief executive officer (CEO) alongside a marked recovery in financial performance and plans to invest in technology designed to adapt to changing consumer habits.
